description: Defines an abstract class AxisRenderer for rendering axes in charting, including initialization methods for titles, tick labels, line formats, and gridlines within the PdfSharp.Charting.Renderers namespace.

classes.name: AxisRenderer
classes.description: Abstract base class for rendering chart axes, providing common initialization methods for axis titles, tick labels, line formats, and gridlines.

methods.name: InitAxisTitle
methods.description: Initializes axis title properties in renderer info, using default font if attributes are missing.

methods.name: InitTickLabels
methods.description: Initializes tick label properties in renderer info, using default font if attributes are missing.

methods.name: InitAxisLineFormat
methods.description: Initializes line formats for axis lines, tick marks, and major/minor tick mark lines.

methods.name: InitGridlines
methods.description: Initializes gridline line formats for major and minor gridlines.

methods.name: GetDefaultTickLabelsFormat
methods.description: Abstract method to get default format string for tick labels.
